issues.problem: Four-member dvandva with no ca in the Sanskrit: Hindi takes commas only (glossary 3.15/3.16); the added और is unmarked.

upasthitam is neuter acc. sg. and the only neuter noun in the list is mitra-vyasanam, so it may agree with that (an ally's calamity that has arisen) rather than with the whole list; the bracketed '[any such]' and the Hindi 'या उपस्थित को' rest on the drafter's choice. Also vā may join the final item (tan-nimittām ... vṛddhim). Text left as drafted (confidence already low).

patch.text: Alternative: upasthitam (n.) may agree with mitra-vyasanam ('an ally's calamity that has arisen'), and the vā may then join the last item ('or his own growth caused by that').
